page_title: NOT 2-3 BHA | Nottingham Forest v Brighton 25/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+12' That's the end of the match.
90+11' The resulting set piece from Nottingham is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+11' A header by Ryan Yates (Nottingham) from very close range goes towards the right-hand post, but doesn't get past Bart Verbruggen, who makes a brilliant save.
90+8' Nottingham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+6' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) and Callum Hudson-Odoi perform a quick tiki-taka to get past two defenders and then continue the move along the side line.
90+4' Yellow card. Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
90+3' Nottingham hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
90' There will be a minimum of 10 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Ola Aina did his best and is replaced by Neco Williams (Nottingham).
85' Brighton can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
84' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) and Moussa Niakhate matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
82' The referee Anthony Taylor awards Bart Verbruggen (Brighton) a yellow card.
80' The Nottingham players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
77' Here is a change. Evan Ferguson is going off and Roberto De Zerbi gives the last tactical orders to Jakub Moder (Brighton).
77' Substitution. Carlos Baleba (Brighton) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Billy Gilmour walks off.
76' 2 - 3 Goal! Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Bart Verbruggen.
76' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
74' The referee cannot ignore such behaviour. Evan Ferguson (Brighton) sees a yellow card and needs to watch himself for the rest of the game.
74' The referee gives a yellow card to Moussa Niakhate (Nottingham) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
73' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) is sent off for dissent after saying something out of turn to the referee!
72' What was Lewis Dunk (Brighton) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
72' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
72' Referee Anthony Taylor makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
72' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Nottingham for a penalty. Play continues.
71' Murillo (Nottingham) sends a long ball in, but Bart Verbruggen comfortably gathers the ball.
69' Steven Cooper prepares a substitution. Nicolas Dominguez is replaced by Ryan Yates (Nottingham).
66' A cross from a corner kick by Nottingham is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
65' Simon Adingra (Brighton) is booked.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Chris Wood leaves the pitch and Divock Origi (Nottingham) comes on.
63' A cross into the box from Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) is cleared.
62' Steven Cooper decides to make a substitution. Danilo will be replaced by Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham).
58' 1 - 3 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Joao Pedro (Brighton) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Odysseas Vlachodimos no chance!
58' Joao Pedro (Brighton) is going to take the penalty!

58' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle after Chris Wood (Nottingham) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Joy for one side, despair for the other as the referee gives a penalty to Brighton!
54' Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
54' Ola Aina (Nottingham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Bart Verbruggen, who smothers the ball.
53' Danilo (Nottingham) meets a fine cross on the edge of the box from the resulting corner kick and shoots. His shot flies just wide of the left post.
52' Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
50' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) attempts to score from a mid-range free kick, but he curls his effort a few inches over the crossbar.
49' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) sets the ball up and is ready to take the free kick from a promising distance. Many goals have been scored from this distance. Let's see what happens.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Roberto De Zerbi gives a chance to Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) and Adam Lallana is off.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+8' Anthony Taylor has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+7' Ola Aina (Nottingham) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
45+4' 1 - 2 Goal! Pascal Gross swings the ball deep into the box and finds Joao Pedro (Brighton) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper into the bottom right corner. 1:2.
45+2' The ball is cleared after Adam Lallana (Brighton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
45' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' Chris Wood (Nottingham) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Bart Verbruggen makes a comfortable save.
43' Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
43' Ola Aina (Nottingham) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Nottingham get a corner.
41' The current number of shots on goal is 1:2.
39' Billy Gilmour (Brighton) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Anthony Taylor signals.
35' Problems for Roberto De Zerbi as Tariq Lamptey is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) replaces him.
34' The game is interrupted now, Tariq Lamptey (Brighton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
33' Billy Gilmour (Brighton) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar.
33' Pascal Gross (Brighton) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
32' Pascal Gross (Brighton) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Brighton are awarded a corner kick.
31' Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
29' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Brighton players have a reason to celebrate!
28' Wait! Referee Anthony Taylor has indicated he is going to review the Brighton goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
26' 1 - 1 Goal! Pascal Gross tees up Evan Ferguson (Brighton) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
21' Ansu Fati (Brighton) doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Joao Pedro comes onto the pitch to replace him.
20' Ansu Fati (Brighton) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

18' Billy Gilmour (Brighton) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. Odysseas Vlachodimos pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
18' Tariq Lamptey (Brighton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
16' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brighton comes to nothing.
14' Billy Gilmour (Brighton) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
9' A dangerous looking corner kick from Pascal Gross (Brighton) is cleared to safety by the defence.
7' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Nottingham.

3' 1 - 0 Goal! Morgan Gibbs-White plays a neat lofted pass into the box for Anthony Elanga (Nottingham), who beats the defender in the air and plants a header into the bottom right corner from close range. 1:0.
2' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) smashes the ball upfield and Simon Adingra controls it with a great first touch.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Nottingham will kick-off.
Anthony Taylor was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
Show lineups
